title: GrowWithHR Apprentices Wave 5H Governed Source and Classification Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Apprentices official source-identity snapshot
sourcePack.notes: Wave 5H records official Act, Rules/amendment, DGT trade registers and portal/scheme source identities. Exact controlled full-file Drive mirrors are not yet present in the active Source Register. Current Rules and portal-summary wording must be reconciled rather than silently harmonised.

limitations: The catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not an Apprentices Act applicability, mandatory-engagement, apprentice-number, statutory-band, State-variation, trade/category, individual-eligibility, contract, stipend, certification, enforcement or remedy determination.
DGT base Rules and overview pages are source context only and cannot override later Gazette amendments or current India Code text.
Only privacy-safe organisation-level source, reconciliation, classification-source, authority, infrastructure and escalation controls plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

chunks.title: Apprentices Act application and classification boundary
chunks.text: The current Apprentices Act source provides the statutory application, definition and authority framework. Wave 5H records organisation-level source and classification controls only and does not decide whether the Act applies to a customer, area or industry.

chunks.title: Designated and optional trade statutory boundary
chunks.text: The Act distinguishes designated trade and optional trade routes and regulates optional trades separately. Wave 5H may record a declared trade-route classification control but cannot classify a customer role, occupation or course as legally designated or optional.

chunks.title: Apprentice-number and authority source boundary
chunks.sectionReference: Section 8 and State amendments; sections 27 and 35
chunks.text: Section 8 and related State amendments contain apprentice-number and authority-sensitive rules. Wave 5H treats worker-strength bands, State variations and Apprenticeship Adviser routing as source controls only; it performs no headcount calculation or mandatory-engagement determination.

chunks.title: Base Apprenticeship Rules source boundary
chunks.text: The DGT-hosted Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 file supplies the base rule structure, including optional-trade and apprentice-number provisions. It is not treated as a fully current consolidated text because later amendments must be reconciled separately.

chunks.title: 2025 Apprenticeship Amendment Rules source boundary
chunks.text: G.S.R. 610(E), the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2025, took effect on publication in September 2025 and amended definitions, category rules, Rule 7B, stipend, portal-contract and schedule provisions. Wave 5H uses it as current amendment context only and does not decide individual eligibility, stipend or contract validity.

chunks.title: Current Rules versus portal-summary reconciliation control
chunks.sectionReference: Rule 7B amendment compared with DGT Apprenticeship Training overview
chunks.text: Current official materials are not perfectly synchronized: the 2025 amendment changes Rule 7B's annual engagement band to 2.5 percent to 15 percent while some DGT overview text still reflects older wording. Wave 5H therefore requires a current-rules-versus-portal reconciliation control and cannot rely on portal summary text to calculate an obligation.

chunks.title: DGT category and trade overview boundary
chunks.sectionReference: DGT Apprenticeship Training overview, reviewed 7 August 2026
chunks.text: DGT describes designated and optional trade routes and multiple apprentice categories. Wave 5H uses the page as classification-source context only and cannot classify an individual apprentice, qualification, course, establishment or competent authority.

chunks.title: Designated-trades register boundary
chunks.sectionReference: DGT List of Designated Trades, reviewed 7 August 2026
chunks.text: The DGT designated-trades register is a source for whether a trade name appears in the current designated-trade catalogue. Retrieval cannot select a trade for the customer, infer equivalence from job titles or decide qualification, training duration or examination requirements.

chunks.title: Optional-trades register boundary
chunks.sectionReference: DGT Optional Trades syllabus register, reviewed 7 August 2026
chunks.text: The DGT optional-trades register is a source for optional-trade course references. Retrieval cannot create an optional trade, approve a curriculum, decide whether a role may be treated as optional or infer an apprentice's category from a job title.

chunks.title: NAPS-2 scheme and portal-process boundary
chunks.text: NAPS-2 guidelines describe scheme implementation and the apprenticeship portal lifecycle. Wave 5H treats NAPS-2 as scheme and portal-process context only; it does not decide scheme eligibility, reimbursement, DBT, contract approval or statutory applicability.

chunks.title: Apprenticeship India portal lifecycle boundary
chunks.text: The Apprenticeship India portal is a process surface for establishment and candidate registration, opportunities and contract lifecycle. Portal state cannot create or replace the statutory classification, current-rule reconciliation, authority routing or legal-review controls.

chunks.title: Privacy and specialist-only boundary
chunks.text: Wave 5H excludes apprentice identities, age, disability, caste or category data, educational records, Aadhaar, bank or stipend data, contract bodies, training dates, attendance, assessment, certificates, medical or injury data, disputes, notices, orders and evidence bodies. Individual eligibility, reservation, stipend, training, certification, enforcement and remedy matters remain specialist-only.
